Hi Priya and Marissa,

Thanks again for the great demo last week. ScoutWorks runs a series of small local meetups for technical community leaders (they call them "Scouts") and we discussed offering those leaders a small trial allowance to help them evaluate Redwood for local workshops.

- Program: ScoutWorks Local Leaders onboarding

Appreciate any quick confirmation,

Hi Elena — looping you in on internal folks.

Thanks for the overview — this sounds like a straightforward partner credit request and a nice fit for our community program. Before I finalize with Finance/Legal, two quick clarifying questions so we provision the codes correctly:

1) Redemption model: do you want single-use codes or one-off codes that can be consumed multiple times by the same leader? (We typically issue single-use per-person codes for fairness.)
2) Target audience: will leaders register on a shared signup page (we can restrict redemption by email domain) or are codes going to be distributed freely?

If we do single-use codes with a 30-day redemption window, I can route to Markus for authorization — I expect a quick approval if there are no special billing terms.

Next steps: once we confirm the two items above I will:
- request the code batch from Ops (scoped to ScoutWorks)
- attach the short partner credit addendum for your signature (if Legal requires it)
- confirm delivery method (CSV + Drive link or direct HubSpot import)

Marissa — tagging you because this will touch partner ops distribution and analytics. Markus, if you’re ok with the quantity and no unusual terms, can we authorize this allocation today?

Thanks,

— Priya
